label: Can show cancel
summary: Whether the cancel button of a building track item should be shown.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `visible` condition of a widget in the county view window. It returns true or false.

label: Can show replace
summary: Whether the replace button of a building track item should be shown.
details: Going by its name and its sibling CanShowCancel, it is a true or false check for a replace button. Vanilla does not use it anywhere in the files given.

label: Cancel construction
summary: Cancels the building project the track item stands for.
details: It returns nothing and is run when the player clicks a button in the county view window. What exactly is cancelled is read from its name and the click use, not documented.

label: Building type text
summary: The text naming the type of building of the track item.
details: Vanilla shows it as the text of a label in the county view window. The exact wording is not documented.

label: Cancel tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the cancel button of the track item.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `tooltip` of a widget in the county view window.

label: Construction time left
summary: The text showing how much time is left until the building under construction is finished.
details: Going by its name and its use as a label text in the county view window. The format of the time is not documented.

label: Building under construction
summary: The building that is currently being constructed in this track item.
details: It gives a building, so more functions can follow it, like the name. Vanilla uses it in the holding view text 'Constructing [building name] (finishing [date])', together with GetConstructionEndDate.

label: Construction end date
summary: The date when the current construction finishes, as text.
details: Vanilla puts it in the holding view text 'Constructing [building] (finishing [date])'.

label: Construction progress
summary: A number telling how far the current construction has come.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `value` of a widget in the county view window, which fits a progress bar. The range of the number is not documented.

label: Current building
summary: The building that currently stands in this track item.
details: It gives a building, so more functions can follow it. Vanilla compares its level with the selected building's level and asks it for the cost description of a rebuild.

label: Current building tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the current building of the track item.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `tooltip` of a widget in the county view window.

label: Current level icon
summary: The icon for the level of the current building.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `texture` of an image in the county view window. The game does not document the return type.

label: Next building
summary: The building that this track item would build or upgrade to next.
details: It gives a building, so more functions can follow it. Vanilla reads its level to choose between 'Construct' (level 1) and 'Upgrade to', and shows its name in 'Upgrade to [name]'.

label: Next building tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the next building of the track item.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `tooltip` of a widget in the county view window, in two places.

label: Next construction time
summary: Data about how long it takes to build the next building.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `datacontext` of a widget in the county view window, so the widget shows it with its own sub-parts. The return type is not documented and the exact content is read from the name.

label: Next building cost
summary: Data about the gold cost of the next building.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `datacontext` of a widget in the county view window. It is read from the name that this is the cost of the next building; the return type is not documented.

label: Next level icon
summary: The icon for the level of the next building.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `texture` of an image in the county view window. The game does not document the return type.

label: Next level icon frame
summary: The frame number (a whole number) of the level icon of the next building.
details: Vanilla has it in a commented-out line (`#frame`) in the county view window, so it may be unused in the game as shipped. Going by its name it picks one picture out of a sprite sheet.

label: Next piety cost
summary: Data about the piety cost of the next building.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `datacontext` of a widget in the county view window. The return type is not documented.

label: Next prestige cost
summary: Data about the prestige cost of the next building.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `datacontext` of a widget in the county view window. The return type is not documented.

label: Items after this level
summary: A list of items to show for the levels after the current one.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `datamodel` (the list a widget repeats over) in the county view window, and hides the widget when the list is empty. What the items are is read from the name only.

label: Items before this level
summary: A list of items to show for the levels before the current one.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `datamodel` (the list a widget repeats over) in the county view window. What the items are is read from the name only.

label: Rebuild time
summary: The text showing how long a rebuild takes.
details: Vanilla shows it as a label text in the county view window. The format is not documented.

label: Replace tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the replace button of the track item.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `tooltip` of a widget in the county view window.

label: Selected building
summary: The building the player has selected in this track item.
details: It gives a building, so more functions can follow it. Vanilla asks it for its type icon, type name and name, and compares its level with the current building's level.

label: Selected building blockers
summary: The text listing the reasons why the selected building cannot be built.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the county view window. It is read from the name that it explains what blocks the building.

label: Selected building tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the selected building.
details: Going by its name and the sibling tooltip functions. Vanilla does not use it in the files given.

label: Selected construction time
summary: Data about how long it takes to build the selected building.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `datacontext` of a widget in the county view window. The return type is not documented.

label: Selected building cost
summary: Data about the gold cost of the selected building.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `datacontext` of a widget in the county view window. The return type is not documented.

label: Selected piety cost
summary: Data about the piety cost of the selected building.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `datacontext` of a widget in the county view window. The return type is not documented.

label: Selected prestige cost
summary: Data about the prestige cost of the selected building.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `datacontext` of a widget in the county view window. The return type is not documented.

summary: Goes back from the selection view of the track item.
details: It returns nothing and is run on a click in the county view window. What it goes back from is read from the name only.

details: Vanilla uses it as a `visible` condition, alone and combined with HasNextBuilding.

label: Has next building

label: Has next cost
summary: Whether the next building has a gold cost to show.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `visible` condition of a widget in the county view window. It is read from the name that the cost is gold.

label: Has next piety cost
summary: Whether the next building has a piety cost to show.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `visible` condition of the piety cost widget.

label: Has next prestige cost
summary: Whether the next building has a prestige cost to show.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `visible` condition of the prestige cost widget.

label: Has selected cost
summary: Whether the selected building has a gold cost to show.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `visible` condition of a widget in the county view window. It is read from the name that the cost is gold.

label: Has selected piety cost
summary: Whether the selected building has a piety cost to show.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `visible` condition of the piety cost widget.

label: Has selected prestige cost
summary: Whether the selected building has a prestige cost to show.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `visible` condition of the prestige cost widget.

label: Is constructing
summary: Whether something is being constructed in the track item.
details: Vanilla uses it as a `visible` condition, for example together with IsConstructingReplacement to tell a normal build from a replacement.

label: Is constructing replacement

details: Vanilla uses it as a `visible` condition, also negated, to show different parts for a replacement and a normal build.

label: Is current building selected
summary: Whether the player has the current building selected in the track item.
details: Vanilla uses it for the `down` state (button looks pressed) and `alwaystransparent` of widgets in the county view window, and in a `visible` condition.

label: Is great building ruined
summary: Whether the great building of the track item is ruined.
details: Vanilla uses it as a `visible` condition, also negated, to hide the normal upgrade parts when the great building is ruined.

label: Is next building selected
summary: Whether the player has the next building selected in the track item.
details: Vanilla uses it for the `down` state and `alwaystransparent` of widgets in the county view window.

label: Is upgrading via great project
summary: Whether the track item is being upgraded through a great project.
details: Vanilla uses it as a `visible` condition, also negated, next to HasNextBuilding and IsGreatBuildingRuined.

label: On click
summary: Runs the click action of the track item.
details: It returns nothing and is used as the `onclick` of a widget in the county view window. What exactly it does is not documented.

label: On current building click
summary: Runs when the player clicks the current building of the track item.
details: It returns nothing and is used as an `onclick` in the county view window. Going by its name it selects the current building.

label: On next building click
summary: Runs when the player clicks the next building of the track item.
details: It returns nothing and is used as an `onclick` in the county view window. Going by its name it selects the next building.

label: Replace building
summary: Starts replacing the building of the track item.
details: It returns nothing and is used as an `onclick` in the county view window. What exactly is replaced by what is read from its name.

summary: The track item itself, so it can be passed on to another function.
details: Vanilla does not use GUITrackItem.Self directly. Other types' Self appear as arguments, like `recipient.Self`, which is why it is read this way. The game documents nothing more.

label: Show great project upgrade
summary: Opens the great project upgrade for the track item.
details: It returns nothing and is used as an `onclick` in the county view window. What it opens is read from its name.

label: Upgrades via great project
summary: Whether the next upgrade of the track item goes through a great project.
details: Vanilla uses it in the text of a button: for a next building above level 1, the text is one wording when this is true ('CONSTRUCT_BUILDING_PLAN_EXPANSION') and the 'UPGRADE' wording when it is false. For level 1 the text is 'CONSTRUCT'.

label: Original alias name

label: Parent concept text

label: The tooltip itself

summary: The body text of the dialog.
details: Vanilla uses it as a label text in the shared dialogs GUI file, and hides that label when the text is empty.

label: Dialog title

label: Enabled mods
summary: The list of enabled mods for the multiplayer setup.
details: Vanilla uses it as a list in the multiplayer setup GUI file, and to show or hide parts depending on whether the list has items.

label: Save game list

summary: Whether the game visibility is set to public without crossplay.

details: It returns nothing and is used as an `onclick` in the bookmarks GUI file, in two places. What happens after the skip is not documented.

label: Start game
summary: Starts the game from the bookmark screen, going by its name.
details: It returns nothing and is used as `on_finish` in the bookmarks GUI file. What exactly it starts with is read from the name.

label: Play tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the play button.
details: Vanilla uses it as a `tooltip` in the bookmarks GUI file.

label: Reset view
summary: Resets the bookmark screen to its starting state.
details: It returns nothing and is used as an `on_start` (run when a widget appears) in the bookmarks GUI file. What is reset is read from the name.

label: Select bookmark group
summary: Makes the given bookmark group the chosen one.
details: It returns nothing and is used as an `onclick` with the group of the clicked button.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a bookmark group, for example BookmarkGroup.Self

label: The setup itself
summary: The game setup itself, so it can be passed on to another function.
details: Vanilla does not use it on this type. Other types' Self appear as arguments, like `recipient.Self`. The game documents nothing more.

label: Set hovered character
summary: Marks the given bookmark character as the one the mouse is over.
details: It returns nothing and is used as an `on_start` in the bookmarks GUI file. DeselectHoveredBookmarkCharacter undoes it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The bookmark character to mark as hovered.
fields.values: a bookmark character, for example BookmarkCharacter.Self
